stance_basis: letter calling for strict monitoring, regulation, and limitation of ORV use to minimize detrimental effects
summary: Richard Spotts, President of the Montebello Ecology Council, wrote to Secretary Morton urging strict monitoring, regulation, and limitation of ORV use to specific areas where detrimental effects can be minimized. He expressed concern that the Environmental Statement did not encourage necessary regulation of ORV use, and warned that unless ORV use is comprehensively planned, monitored, regulated, and limited, remaining unspoiled open space lands will rapidly be ruined. He voiced support for the Sierra Club and Desert Protective Council's positions on the matter.
complaint_summary: Spotts argues that the Environmental Statement does not encourage necessary regulation of ORV use, calls for strict monitoring, regulation, and limitation of ORV use to specific areas where detrimental effects can be minimized, and warns that unspoiled open space lands will rapidly be ruined unless ORV use is comprehensively planned and controlled.
